function.name: update_course
function.description: Updates one or more fields of an existing Google Classroom course (e.g. rename course, change section/group, update description, or archive course). Pass only the fields that need to be modified. If course_id is unknown, invoke get_courses first.

course_id.description: The unique identifier of the course to update. Never guess or invent an ID.

name.description: New course title. Provide only if the teacher wants to rename the course.

description.description: Updated course description or syllabus summary.

course_state.description: New state of the course. Use 'ARCHIVED' if the teacher asks to archive/close the course.
